The '''SSDS 11-A''' was a Class 3.0 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive unit]] manufactured by [[Sienar Design Systems/Legends|Sienar Design Systems]]. It was used aboard [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul's]] [[Star Courier/Legends|Star Courier]], the [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']].
